segments.comment: B82 C-first source-supported alternative to the retained unpolymorphed corrected11 route, which diverges at allmain.c:moveloop_core lycanthropy chance. Enter a non-were dwarf form before eating the wererat tin; Upolyd then suppresses that separate elapsed-turn gate while cpostfx can assign u.ulycn. Drop the actual carried club, sling, flint, and rocks one at a time, wish a hostile newt, shift to the matching wererat form, dismiss the C-observed form notice, and attack north toward the adjacent target. This is an exploratory recipe; keep it out of recordings unless the complete C trace reaches a source-confirmed AD_WERE bite and strict JS replay matches. Preserved C setup miss from run-oqCzCf: the wizard-wished tin opened magically, so only one space dismissed its message; the second space answered the following Eat it? prompt with the default no. C discarded the open tin and never called cpostfx, then correctly refused the wererat transformation because u.ulycn was unset.
